issues.legal_issue: A fixed asset belonging to the owner of a mine and assigned as a staff vehicle for the mine falls within the statutory definition of a mine and vests in the Central Government upon nationalisation.
material_facts: The vehicle belonged to the company that owned the mine.
The vehicle was a fixed asset and had been placed at the disposal of the mine’s Technical Advisor as his staff car.
The mine was nationalised, and the dispute concerned whether the vehicle vested with it.
issues.conclusion: The staff car was a fixed asset belonging to the mine owner and fell within the definition of a mine under Section 2(h)(xii) of the Coal Mines (Nationalisation) Act, 1973. It therefore vested in the Central Government under Section 3(1).
issues.legal_principle: Sections 2(h)(xii) and 3(1) of the Coal Mines (Nationalisation) Act, 1973 provide for vesting of fixed assets, movable or immovable, belonging to the owner of a mine, wherever situated. Whether an asset falls within the definition depends on whether it answers that description. The Court noted that fixed assets are assets held for conducting a business, as discussed in Words & Phrases, Permanent Edition, Volume 17, page 161, Black’s Law Dictionary, 5th edition, page 573, and Stroud’s Judicial Dictionary, 4th edition, Volume 1, page 201.

rule.if: mine_nationalisation_vesting_case and asset_is_fixed and asset_belongs_to_mine_owner and asset_assigned_as_mine_staff_vehicle

predicates.mine_nationalisation_vesting_case: The proceeding concerns whether an asset connected with a mine vested in the government following nationalisation.
predicates.asset_is_fixed: The asset was held for conducting a business rather than for conversion into cash.
predicates.asset_belongs_to_mine_owner: The asset was owned by the person or entity that owned the mine.
predicates.asset_assigned_as_mine_staff_vehicle: The asset was assigned for use as a staff vehicle by an officer serving the mine.

issues.definition: When a mine-nationalisation vesting dispute concerns a fixed asset belonging to the mine owner that was assigned as a mine staff vehicle, the asset vests in the government.

issues.legal_issue: For an asset claimed under the category of fixed assets belonging to the owner of a mine, subsequent use for other activities does not make the asset’s vesting depend on exclusive mine use or require the dispute to be left for determination in a civil suit.
material_facts: The vehicle belonged to the mine owner and was a fixed asset assigned to the mine’s Technical Advisor as his staff car.
The Technical Advisor said that he also used the vehicle for the wider activities of the owner’s group of industries, which included businesses other than coal mining.
The High Court relied on New Satgram Engineering Works to leave the parties to resolve the dispute in a civil suit.
issues.conclusion: The vehicle’s subsequent use for personal purposes or for the wider activities of the owner’s group did not alter its legal status under Section 2(h)(xii). The High Court erred in requiring the parties to pursue a civil suit; the appeal was allowed and the writ petition was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 2(h)(xii) uses the phrase “belonging to the owner of a mine, wherever situated,” unlike Section 2(h)(xi), which requires specified lands and buildings to be “solely used” for listed mine-related purposes. New Satgram Engineering Works v. Union of India, (1980) 4 SCC 570, addressed the context of Section 2(h)(xi), where the nature of use could be material; it did not govern an asset falling under Section 2(h)(xii). For such an asset, subsequent use for a different purpose is not germane to whether it falls within the definition.

rule.if: vesting_dispute_in_writ_proceeding and asset_claimed_as_owner_fixed_asset and asset_belongs_to_mine_owner and asset_later_used_for_non_mining_purposes

predicates.vesting_dispute_in_writ_proceeding: A party challenged in a writ proceeding whether an asset vested in the government upon mine nationalisation.
predicates.asset_claimed_as_owner_fixed_asset: The asset was claimed to be a fixed asset belonging to the owner of a mine.
predicates.asset_belongs_to_mine_owner: The asset was owned by the person or entity that owned the mine.
predicates.asset_later_used_for_non_mining_purposes: After being assigned for a mine-related role, the asset was also used for personal or other non-mining activities.

issues.definition: In a writ proceeding over vesting, later non-mining use does not prevent vesting when the asset is a fixed asset belonging to the mine owner.
